title: Sell Mineral Rights in Wilson, OH
metaTitle: Sell Mineral Rights in Wilson, OH | Belmont Utica Core
metaDescription: Wilson, Belmont County sits in the Utica core. See how sustained core-area drilling and pooled units shape mineral rights value near this small community.
heroLead: Wilson sits in a part of Belmont County that operators have returned to again and again over the past decade, building out multi-well pads on land that a lot of families never expected to hear from a landman about.
intro: Wilson is a small community in Belmont County, deep within the Utica/Point Pleasant core, an area that has seen some of the most sustained horizontal drilling activity anywhere in the play. Belmont County's combination of thick, liquids-rich pay and significant midstream infrastructure has kept operators actively developing acreage here well beyond the initial leasing rush of the early 2010s.
For mineral owners near Wilson, that sustained activity generally means a real, documentable track record exists for units in the area, whether or not your specific parcel has been drilled yet.

sections.heading: What sustained core development looks like
paragraphs: Unlike counties where drilling activity spiked and then slowed, Belmont County has continued to see new permits and pad development in recent years, reflecting operators' ongoing confidence in the area's production economics.
For unleased acreage near Wilson, that continued activity means a meaningfully different outlook than similar acreage in an area where drilling has largely stopped.

sections.heading: Pooled units and your decimal interest
paragraphs: If your land near Wilson has been pooled into a unit, your royalty share is based on your acreage's proportion of that unit, documented on your division order. This figure is central to pricing a producing or leased interest accurately.
We review your lease and division order, where available, to confirm your exact decimal interest before making an offer.

sections.heading: Selling in an actively developing core county
paragraphs: We check current Ohio Department of Natural Resources permit and production data for the specific township around Wilson, since even within core Belmont County activity is not uniform from one section to the next.
A written offer reflects your documented ownership, lease status, and the surrounding activity, presented as a hedged range rather than a flat guarantee.

faqs.question: Is Belmont County still seeing new drilling, or is it mostly done?
faqs.answer: Belmont County has continued to see permitting and pad development in recent years, more than many other Utica counties, reflecting sustained operator interest.

faqs.question: What is a division order and why does it matter for my interest near Wilson?
faqs.answer: It documents your exact decimal share of a pooled unit's production and is one of the key figures used to price a producing interest accurately.

faqs.question: How do I know if my parcel near Wilson has been pooled into a unit?
faqs.answer: We check Ohio Department of Natural Resources unit and permit records tied to your legal description to confirm this.
